name: hcoll_v7_qso_n2s1_b1

fill_reason.pin_bound: 138 pin bits: N 84 (sink_slot/select + clk/rst/faults) on M5 over 21.6 um = 40% of slots; outline 21.6x21.6 (not 17.28: gate GPL-0301 100% with recipe-2 hold stages on a 168 um2 core, synthesized std 112 um2).

job.purpose: COLL hard_v7 d4f shape ot_hgi_coll_qso_n2s1_b1 (NLINK 2, TP192 die): same leaf RTL as the closed qso3n shape at the d4f link count

hold_eco.reason: HEP w5f recipe (H-ELEM): no input hold pad, HB1 output pad, route hold margin 10 ps, post-route hold ECO goal 5 ps -- ctl2 V7 e11086804 native capture 197.3 was input hold padding

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL already registers every port at the face: qslots_output captures captured/captured_slot/sink_slot/sink_select into _p flops before any logic; dst_v/dst_d/select_fault/unavailable_fault are flop Q. Recipe-2 output stage on: io_flop_at_pins anchors only the OUTPUT launch flops at their pins (OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE), pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs give one launch flop per output pin; inputs keep their inhold pad.

structural_change: Coordinator one-pass qso resize after the qso3w/qso2w FLOORPLAN_MARGIN verdicts (flow std = 1.27x gate synth): expected flow std ~142 um2 = 48% at 21.6x21.6, the lattice size nearest 55% (19.44 -> 62% > 60% cap), so the outline is kept; q3 bench peak_ram_gb 40 -> 128 (q3 lockstep with two KMAX-2048 TKMs SIGKILLed at 40 GB). Plus the recipe-2 output stage (io_flop_at_pins on outputs only, pin_reg_split, keep_pin_regs) so dst launch meets the native 220-ps budget (qcap twin failed launch 240.4 without it).
